ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) and 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large contiguous white region bounded by black lateral/trailing margins, containing a distinct black circular spot at central-lateral coordinates. Right lobe: white region with high-contrast black mottling along the trailing edge and lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations consisting of sharp, jagged peaks and deep vertical valleys (approx. 5-15 pixels) along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave trailing edge curvature leading to acute, upwardly-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, raised, circular clusters of high-contrast tan/white pixels localized on both the left and right distal lobe tips, indicating significant barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned vertical dark linear pixel disruption extending from the circular spot on the left lobe toward the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; distinct circular black pigmentation focal point on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular 'eye-spot' or ocellus black pigmentation feature located within the white field of the left ventral fluke lobe.
